ownerDecision.limits: Submission and case review do not authorize delivery, arbitrary third-party data disclosure or irreversible erasure. No payment or provider-policy changes.

mongoCollections.name: users
mongoCollections.data: Account username, submitted email, bcrypt password hash, creation time, embedded characters, roles, VIP periods and account moderation state/receipts. Characters include progression, inventory, currencies, appearance, location, run state and deduplication receipts. This mainline schema22 inventory excludes future1.76 checkpoint fields. Private optional recovery_email stores address/verified_at. recovery_email_pending and password_recovery store token digests, recipient address, the current password-hash binding and issue/expiry times; no raw bearer token is stored in Mongo.
mongoCollections.retention: No generic account privacy expiry configured. Existing owner decision retains alpha accounts and characters. Stored email alone is not verified account ownership. Verification is valid30minutes, reset15minutes, with1minute issuance cooldown. These are authorization validity checks, not physical retention/TTL deletion. Pending expired challenges remain until replaced or explicitly cleared. Successful email confirmation clears pending verification and prior reset; successful password change/reset clears both challenges. Verified address remains. Never add a Mongo TTL to a nested challenge expiry: it would delete the entire user document.

mongoCollections.name: reports
mongoCollections.data: Authenticated author, type, player-provided text, timestamps, status and private review information. An explicitly attached playtest summary becomes report text. The unpublished1.75 branch adds case-local export permission and private bounded replay receipts, separately from ordinary case review. Permission metadata contains staff identity, reason, time, revisions and request fingerprint; it contains no export artifact or owner password. No new collection or TTL is introduced.
mongoCollections.retention: No report TTL configured; resolution does not delete the report. Owner approved preserving current retention for the initial administrator-reviewed privacy workflow; no automatic deletion.

mongoCollections.name: admin_activity
mongoCollections.data: Bounded actor/target identity, action, request correlation, time, result, summary and applicable operator reason. Login/disconnect activity uses the same history. Maintenance1.74.2 additionally records optional session_started_at on future disconnects, representing closed authenticated connection duration, not AFK/active gameplay. Administrator real/test/all filters and UTC-day totals read existing retained activity; distinct-account maps and derived totals are bounded ephemeral response data, not a new analytics collection or stored per-player profile. No historical duration backfill or test-account deletion. Older digest-only identities cannot be classified from their hash.
mongoCollections.retention: Existing default 90 days, configurable within 7–365 days. Reads enforce the current cutoff; Mongo TTL uses each record's original expiry and is asynchronous. A shorter setting does not instantly physically delete all older records.

mongoCollections.name: admin_operations
mongoCollections.data: Actor/recipient identity, exact request fingerprint, operation state, audit and pending grant/teleport execution plan.
mongoCollections.retention: Permanent replay identity is separate from expiring history. Completion removes the execution payload; do not expire deduplication identities to retry a grant.

mongoCollections.name: friendships

mongoCollections.retention: Gameplay relationship changes are implemented; generic privacy retention and account-removal handling remain policy work.

mongoCollections.retention: Shared custody and other members' rights require reconciliation before account removal; no generic privacy TTL configured.

mongoCollections.retention: Existing expires_at Mongo TTL; invitation expiry is not a general deletion policy for guild/member records.

Only own participation, cards/hands, stakes, slot entitlement/last-result summary and own pending currency/amount are emitted. Other players, hidden cards/decks/bonus offers, private tokens/replay/next-state plans remain omitted. Current overwritten state is not complete historical play or independent wallet delivery proof.

otherStores.data: Authenticated connection/account bindings and CSPRNG single-use resume tokens. Unpublished1.75 captures the credential-bearing Mongo account ID with exact hash/ID post-bcrypt proof, pins it privately to the connection and captures it in token metadata. Join/reconnect check current DB/live identity without per-frame reads; missing/reused accounts or late failures refuse. No account ID is added to browser/token payloads or public state. Tokens rotate/revoke and the existing resume window is five minutes after transport closure; server restart loses this memory. Dungeon long-logout behavior separately retains the 15-minute rule.
otherStores.boundary: Never put bearer tokens in public events, reports, logs or support exports. Browser persistence does not make a token valid indefinitely.

otherStores.data: World/party/guild/whisper messages with sender/recipient metadata, reply targets and visibility restrictions. Existing history limit is 50 entries per history bucket.
otherStores.boundary: No chat-message Mongo collection is registered. Reports can still contain copied chat evidence. RAM-only does not imply zero exposure, a global size cap or an approved retention policy.

otherStores.data: Pending complete character images or exact activity/guild-clear/PvP recovery records with identities. Journal directories are created with mode0700; exact receipts are acknowledged only by their recovery contract.
otherStores.boundary: Not public artifacts. Do not wipe pending journals as privacy cleanup; reconcile them with the matching Mongo recovery point. Unpublished production snapshot/shutdown/offline producers carry loaded account ObjectID into version2 records; write/replay/receipt proof rejects rebinding/downgrade and retains rejected evidence. Production startup refuses legacy pending files before DB initialization/migration; schema23 fences old version1 writers without backfill. Actual release transition/recovery acceptance and session/other-operation/archive coordination remain open. Repository modes do not certify actual host ownership or encryption.

otherStores.data: Mongo archives may contain all account hashes, allegations and private receipts. Application/edge logs may contain connection addresses and diagnostic identifiers. Prepared WebSocket diagnostics omit arbitrary peer close text.
otherStores.boundary: Actual archive location, access, copies, rotation, encryption and edge log format were not inspected here. These remain owner/operations choices; removing a live row cannot guarantee removal from every backup.

otherStores.data: Synthetic browser traces, screenshots and runtime evidence; credentialed paths suppress recording and the prepared sanitizer handles supported artifacts.

otherStores.data: Transactional HTTPS requests send configured sender/recipient, stream, subject and text body to Postmark. Verify/reset bodies contain the account identifier and one-use private fragment link. Opens/links tracking is explicitly disabled; no CC/BCC or administrator copy. Provider response identifier is checked for acceptance, not retained as an inbox-delivery receipt.
otherStores.boundary: Two joined workers and32queued jobs hold limited page-independent raw token/address data in RAM, with8second HTTP timeout and no redirects. Generic logs omit recipient/link/token/provider body. POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN remains operator configuration, not player/export data. Provider-side retention/access/deletion and backups need owner/provider review; configuration presence and local TLS tests do not prove inbox delivery. The operator example also reserves ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAILS for separate notifications; recovery ignores that list. No raw .env, provider token or real sender/recipient values were inspected by this inventory.

otherStores.data: Blocking head script recognizes a private fragment, marks the page sensitive and attempts history replacement before analytics bootstrap. Validated account/token handoff lives in page-local RAM and requires explicit confirmation/reset submission; opening a link alone does not consume it.
otherStores.boundary: Analytics loader is suppressed for the private page even if history replacement fails or the fragment is invalid. This does not remove copies held by the mail provider, mailbox/browser software or a player screenshot. Never include the handoff or raw URL in support exports, reports or QA artifacts.
